# Locations & Battles

## Avenue {#avenue}

The Avenue is a four- or five-hundred-yard stretch of road leading to [Newbridge](../codex/places.md#newbridge), lined with old apple trees whose canopy creates a snowy, fragrant tunnel of bloom.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P40](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0040), [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P41](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0041), [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P42](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0042), [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P43](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0043), +23 more_

## Avonlea {#avonlea}

Avonlea is the hometown of a group of young scholars who left to attend the Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl P1](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl P2](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl P3](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl P4](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0004), +42 more_

**Associated with:** [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Barbara Shaw](../character/barbara-shaw.md), [Elisha Wright](../character/elisha-wright.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Lorenzo White](../character/lorenzo-white.md), [Major Spencer](../character/major-spencer.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Robert Bell](../character/robert-bell.md)

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) debate Mrs. Lynde's virtues and discuss the village hall painting project. Later, [Joshua Pye](../character/joshua-pye.md) paints the hall a bright blue instead of green due to a mix-up with paint numbers, causing dismay among the [Improvers](../codex/factions.md#improvers). Despite the hideous result, public sympathy turns in favor of the [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers), and the community rallies around them.
>
> — v2 · IX A Question of Color

_Sources: [v2 IX A Question of Color P0](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0000), [v2 IX A Question of Color P28](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0028), [v2 IX A Question of Color P32](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0032), [v2 IX A Question of Color P40](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0040)_

## Beechwood {#beechwood}

Beechwood is the residence of Diana's [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) located in town.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out P5](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out P6](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. > [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) visit [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) at Beechwood in [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown) for the [Exhibition](../codex/places.md#exhibition). They spend several exciting days enjoying the fair, visiting the park, and attending a concert before Mr. [Barry](../character/barry.md) drives them back home.
>

Bingen is a location on the [Rhine](../codex/places.md#rhine) featured in a piece of poetry.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P15](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0015), [v1 CHAPTER V. ## Birch Path {#birch-path}

Named by [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), the Birch Path is a picturesque, narrow, and spicy-aired pathway fringed with young birches and wildflowers that winds through Mr. Bell's woods on the route to the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P70](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0070), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P0](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P1](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P2](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0002), +17 more_

> On her thirteenth birthday, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) walks to school with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) down the Birch Path, discussing their growing up and Anne's melodramatic composition assignment. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) proposes starting a story club, which quickly expands to include other schoolmates. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discusses the club and its moral lessons with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P3](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P4](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P19](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0019), [v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P21](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0021)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) debate the ethics and effectiveness of corporal punishment in school teaching on the eve of the school year. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) then visits Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), who also doubts her plan to rule by affection rather than the rod, leaving [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) anxious about her upcoming first day of teaching.
>
> — v2 · IV Different Opinions

_Sources: [v2 IV Different Opinions P0](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0000), [v2 IV Different Opinions P7](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0007), [v2 IV Different Opinions P35](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0035), [v2 IV Different Opinions P41](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0041)_

## Bolingbroke {#bolingbroke}

Bolingbroke is a place in [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia) where [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) was born, featuring a high school where her parents taught and a small yellow house where her family lived before she became an orphan.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P7](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P8](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER V. **Associated with:** [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Shirley](../character/shirley.md)

## Boston {#boston}

Boston is a noisy, crowded city where [Jordan](../character/jordan.md) Gray worked for a winter and Hester Murray worked in a store prior to their marriage, and where [Jordan](../character/jordan.md) returned following her death.

_Sources: [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P47](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0047), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P48](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0048), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P49](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0049), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P50](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0050), +8 more_

**Associated with:** [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md)

## Bright River {#bright-river}

Bright River is a location reachable by an eight-mile drive from [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) Cuthbert's home, featuring a train station house with a long platform and ladies' waiting room, as well as a small local hotel.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P12](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0012), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P14](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P15](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0015), +26 more_

> [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) travels to Bright River to pick up an orphan boy, only to learn from the stationmaster that a girl was left for him instead. Shy [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) decides to take the talkative orphan girl back to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) rather than leaving her behind, listening to her enthusiastic chatter along the way.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised

Carmody is a nearby community with a school taught by [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), as well as shopping facilities accessed via a road connecting it with [White Sands](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel) and [Newbridge](../codex/places.md#newbridge).

the Dryad’s Bubble is a spring located near a log bridge and surrounded by ferns and birch trees, named by [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P36](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0036), [v1 CHAPTER XII. > [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) boasts to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about being good by sharing his jam bread with [Dora](../character/dora.md) before kneeling to say his prayers. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) later meets [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) by Dryad's Bubble, where they discuss the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Improvement Society's progress and school developments. Upon returning home, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) talks with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) about her busy schedule for the next day.

## East Grafton {#east-grafton}

East Grafton is a settlement home to a gravely ill distant relative of [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) named [Mary](../character/mary-joe.md), whose residents did not get along particularly well with her.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P12](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0012), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P13](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0013), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P14](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0014), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P15](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0015), +14 more_

## Echo Lodge {#echo-lodge}

Echo Lodge is a stone house inhabited by Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), which is scheduled to be boarded up and left empty during the winters while being used as a summer home following her marriage.

_Sources: [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P73](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0073), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P74](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0074), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P75](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0075), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P76](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0076), +15 more_

**Associated with:** [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md)

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to teaching school, where [Dora](../character/dora.md) is frightened by [Mirabel](../character/mirabel-cotton.md) Cotton's stories about a ghost relative. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) walk through the woods to go to [West Grafton](../codex/places.md#west-grafton), but lose their way and discover Echo Lodge, the quaint stone home of Miss [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and her young helper, Charlotta the Fourth. Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) warmly invites them to stay for a imaginary tea party she had set up to combat loneliness.
>
> — v2 · XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P53](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0053)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) share tea with Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and her maid Charlotta the Fourth at Echo Lodge, where Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) explains her imaginary party and the origin of her echoes. After [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) demonstrates the echoing tin horn and Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) explains her maid's given name, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) inadvertently mentions [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md). Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) briefly inquires about [Stephen](../character/stephen-irving.md) Irving's son before bidding the girls a wistful goodbye.
>
> — v2 · XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P62](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0062), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P71](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0071), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P81](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0081), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P87](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0087)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) at Echo Lodge on a wintry evening, and over tea and candy, Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) recounts her long-ago romance and quarrel with [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md). A month later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) introduces Stephen's son, [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md), to Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), and the two immediately form a fond friendship during their visit.
>
> — v2 · XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance

_Sources: [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P4](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0004), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P10](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0010), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P17](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0017), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P26](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0026)_

> At [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) dresses in a new pale green dress and converses with [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and [Dora](../character/dora.md) before leaving for Echo Lodge. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) then walk to Echo Lodge, where they eat lunch and visit with Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and Charlotta the Fourth in the garden. Afterward, [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) plays with the echoes while [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) set out to pick early strawberries for tea.
>
> — v2 · XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House

_Sources: [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P1](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0001), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P22](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0022), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P31](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0031), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P37](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0037)_

> Charlotta the Fourth expresses concern to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about Miss Lavendar's unusual despondency and apathy. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) promises to come stay for a week during her vacation to help cheer Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) up. Meanwhile, Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) bond over their shared experiences with imaginary dream-people before [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) head home.
>
> — v2 · XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House

## Green Gables {#green-gables}

> [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) suddenly collapses and dies after reading a notice about the failure of the Abbey Bank. After his funeral, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) comfort each other in their shared grief. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) talks with Mrs. Allan about finding moments of joy amidst her sorrow, and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) reflects on her past romantic history with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) Blythe's father.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) discuss Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers) plans on their drive home from [Carmody](../codex/places.md#carmody) when they spot a Jersey cow trampling Mr. Harrison's oat field. Believing the cow is her own nuisance Jersey, [Dolly](../character/dolly.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) impulsively sells the stray cow on the spot to Mr. [Shearer](../character/shearer.md) for twenty dollars. Upon returning to Green Gables, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discovers [Dolly](../character/dolly.md) still in the barnyard and realizes she accidentally sold Mr. Harrison's cow, prompting her to head over to his house with the money and a cake to confess.
>

> Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) visits Green Gables to meet [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), but offends her with blunt remarks about her red hair and looks. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) flies into a fiery rage, shouting at Mrs. Lynde before storming off to her bedroom. After Mrs. Lynde leaves in huff, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) confronts [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) upstairs and orders her to remain in her room until she agrees to apologize.
>

Green Gables prepares to host the new minister and his wife for tea, with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) making a layer cake for Mrs. Allan. ## Rhine {#rhine}

The Rhine is a river referenced in the poem "[Bingen](../codex/places.md#bingen) on the Rhine," which is both memorized by [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and recited by [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P15](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0015), [v1 CHAPTER V. ## Rome {#rome}

Rome is a city referenced in the adage that its building was not the work of a single day.

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P6](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0006), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P7](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0007), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P9](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0009), +5 more_

## Snow Queen {#snow-queen}

Snow Queen is the name given by [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) to a white-blossomed cherry tree growing outside her bedroom window.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables P31](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0031), [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables P32](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0032), [v1 CHAPTER IV. ## Spain {#spain}

_Not yet known._

## Spencervale {#spencervale}

Spencervale is a settlement ten miles from Anne's home, featuring farms and a solitary, spruce-lined pathway known as the [Tory Road](../codex/places.md#tory-road).

_Sources: [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P12](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0012), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P13](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0013), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P14](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0014), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P15](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0015), +10 more_

**Associated with:** [Chester Ross](../character/chester-ross.md)

## States {#states}

The States is a foreign country where [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md) went into business with his uncle, married a [American](../codex/factions.md#american) woman, and raised his son [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) before sending him back to Prince [Edward Island](../codex/places.md#edward-island).

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P41](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0041), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P42](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0042), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P43](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0043), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P44](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0044), +8 more_

**Associated with:** [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md)

## Sunday School {#sunday-school}

Sunday School is a religious program attended by children such as Willie White, featuring prayers led by a superintendent like Mr. Bell.

_Sources: [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P4](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0004), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P5](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0005), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P6](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0006), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P7](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0007), +16 more_

## Thanksgiving {#thanksgiving}

Thanksgiving is a holiday celebrated in November, though [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) expressed a preference for holding it in May when everything is alive.

_Sources: [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P4](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0004), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P5](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0005), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P6](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0006), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P7](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0007), +5 more_

## Toronto {#toronto}

Toronto is the place of residence for Mrs. Charlotte E. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md), the author of 'Edgewood Days' and 'The Rosebud Garden.'

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P3](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0003), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P4](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0004), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P5](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0005), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P6](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0006), +5 more_

## Tory Road {#tory-road}

The Tory Road is a green, quiet highway in [Spencervale](../codex/places.md#spencervale) lined with young spruces, built by a [Tory](../codex/factions.md#conservative) government and inhabited only by the Copp sisters and [Martin](../character/martin.md) Bovyer.

_Sources: [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P12](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0012), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P13](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0013), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P14](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0014), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P15](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0015), +20 more_

## Victoria Island {#victoria-island}

Victoria Island is a location up the brook featuring two maple trees surrounded by flowing water, discovered and named by [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) on the Queen's birthday.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XX. A Good Imagination Gone Wrong P6](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER XX. A Good Imagination Gone Wrong P7](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER XX. A Good Imagination Gone Wrong P8](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER XX. ## Violet Vale {#violet-vale}

Named by [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), Violet Vale is a little green dimple situated beyond [Willowmere](../codex/places.md#willowmere) in the shadow of Mr. Andrew Bell's big woods, famous for having millions of violets in the spring.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P70](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0070), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P0](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XV. ## West Grafton {#west-grafton}

West Grafton is a location accessible via a road that can be reached by walking straight back through the woods from the [Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) farm.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P8](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0008), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P9](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0009), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P10](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0010), +20 more_

## White Sands Hotel {#white-sands-hotel}

Located along the shore road, the White Sands Hotel is run by Mr. Kirke and serves as a summer resort popular with [American](../codex/factions.md#american) visitors.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P21](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P22](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0022), [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P23](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0023), [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P24](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0024), +18 more_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) prepares at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for a charity concert at the White Sands Hotel, assisted by [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and checked by [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). After driving over with [Billy](../character/billy-andrews.md), [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) experiences severe stage fright on the hotel platform, but recovers upon seeing [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) in the crowd and performs brilliantly to enthusiastic applause.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert
